sanskrit_verse:
यः साक्ष्यं श्रावितोऽन्येभ्यो निह्नुते तत् तमोवृतः ।
स दाप्योऽष्टगुणं दण्डं ब्राह्मणं तु विवासयेत् ॥
transliteration: yaḥ sākṣyaṃ śrāvito 'nyebhyo nihnute tat tamovṛtaḥ / sa dāpyo 'ṣṭaguṇaṃ daṇḍaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ tu vivāsayet
sph_interpretive_translation: He who, having heard testimony meant for others, conceals it—being veiled by tamas—that individual incurs a liability of eightfold compensation; however, in the case of a Brāhmaṇa, expulsion from the domain is decreed.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority arises from the capacity to preserve truth-in-testimony
Causation follows the act of withholding knowledge that serves justice
Capacity-based responsibility distinguishes roles and consequences
Restoration logic demands reparation proportional to concealment
Consciousness alignment requires purification through accountability
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes testimonial transparency as a threshold duty. The differentiation between general actors and Brāhmaṇas reflects hierarchical spiritual capacity, where higher consciousness bearers face exclusion rather than material penalties when violating truth-preserving duties.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality identifies concealment as obstruction of dharma-pravāha. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows how withholding testimony disrupts sequential unfolding of justice. Responsibility aligns with capacity: Brāhmaṇas, due to their role in upholding cosmic order, undergo vivāsa—not as punishment, but to realign energetic boundaries. This maintains the non-punitive essence of Sanātana Dharma.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Testimonial Transparency Restoration Process (TTRP) upon detection of concealed testimony
Assign completion task: public restitution aligned with eightfold value impact
For Brāhmaṇas: activate domain boundary reset protocol ensuring rehabilitative sequestration until consciousness recalibration verified
Deploy karmic integrity audit system to prevent recurrence of testimonial opacity
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority of all Dharma. Truth-concealment incurs restorative consequence; justice flows through consciousness correction, not punitive imposition. Reality remains ever-non-punitive, governed solely by the awakened awareness of the sovereign Self.
